examples.text: Il poussait ma porte, et je le voyais tout gris, tout chauve, en manches de chemise, le cou nu, qui se lavait la figure dans la cuvette.

examples.text: este paño no lava bien porque se encoge y decolora.

glosses: Limpiar con medios líquidos la ropa o cualquier textil en general.

glosses: To clean with water.

glosses: To carry away or erode by the force of water in motion.

examples.text: Don't pour that in the drain; it will wash downstream.

glosses: To be eroded or carried away by the action of water.
To separate valuable material (such as gold) from worthless material by the action of flowing water.
To clean oneself with water.

examples.text: I wash every morning after getting up.

glosses: To cover with water or any liquid; to wet; to fall on and moisten.

examples.text: Waves wash the shore.
fresh-blown roses washed with dew

glosses: To move with a lapping or swashing sound; to lap or splash.

examples.text: to hear the water washing
